My only build.sbt change was one line, reframe4sRevision -> 5f7152aada60335935843ddc968162f615337415. It is now on origin/main via PR #13 (merge b49c2e80), landed by cherry-pick onto origin/main, not by pushing local main.
Note for your pin update: origin/main and local main have diverged (local main is about 45 commits ahead, including your atlas-workflows integration). If you bump image4s on local main, keep reframe4s at 5f7152aa; if you land through a PR from origin/main, start from b49c2e80. Sync follow-up ticket: bd-01M3ZGFS1WNA76Q1HJXN5BTE60.
